name: model-council
description: Ask a council of local and cloud AI models for individual, categorized, pooled, dialectic, or deconflicted answers.

interface.shortDescription: Compare and synthesize answers from multiple models.
interface.longDescription: Route questions and repository reviews to a configurable council of local, subscription-backed, and API-hosted models.
defaultPrompt: Ask the model council to review this decision.
Compare model opinions on my current approach.
Run a council review of my uncommitted changes.
